title: Committee of Supply debate on the Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment budget
what_it_is: A Committee of Supply debate on Head L of the Estimates for the Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment, covering climate adaptation, water, food, heat, waste and related policies.
stage: Committee of Supply debate on Head L of the Estimates
why_it_matters: The transcript states that from April the Beverage Container Return Scheme will add a 10-cent deposit on marked beverage containers, refundable at reverse vending machines, and that climate vouchers will be expanded next month to include five-tick clothes dryers and induction stoves. It also states that 2026 is designated the Year of Climate Adaptation, that a National Adaptation Plan will be published in 2027, and that portable flood barriers and flood alerts are being made available to residents.

key_points.point: Ms Poh Li San moved an amendment to reduce the total sum allocated for Head L of the Estimates by $100.
key_points.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
key_points.quote: That the total sum to be allocated for Head L of the Estimates be reduced by $100

key_points.point: The Government will designate 2026 as the Year of Climate Adaptation.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We will designate 2026 as the Year of Climate Adaptation to galvanise this collective effort on adaptation.

key_points.point: Singapore's first National Adaptation Plan will be published in 2027 and implemented in the years to come.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Inputs from members of the public will shape our first National Adaptation Plan, which we will publish in 2027 and implement in the years to come.

key_points.point: The Coastal Protection Bill will be tabled in Parliament for Second Reading.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We will table the Coastal Protection Bill in Parliament for Second Reading, which, when passed, will give us the legislation and regulatory powers to implement our coastal protection plan.

key_points.point: Conceptual studies for the North-west Coast from Tuas to Lim Chu Kang have been completed.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We are pleased to share that we have now completed conceptual studies for the North-west Coast from Tuas to Lim Chu Kang.

key_points.point: Site-specific studies for Sentosa and the Southwest Coast will commence this year.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Site-specific studies for Sentosa and the Southwest Coast will commence this year.

key_points.point: Drainage improvement works will be carried out at Bedok First Subsidiary Drain and Sungei Serangoon Eastern and Western subsidiary drains.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: we will be carrying out drainage improvement works to Bedok First Subsidiary Drain and Sungei Serangoon Eastern and Western subsidiary drains to reduce flood risks.

key_points.point: Drainage improvements to 900 metres of the Bukit Timah Canal will be completed this year.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We will also complete drainage improvements to 900 metres of the Bukit Timah Canal between Rifle Range Road and Jalan Kampong Chantek this year.

key_points.point: The Climate and Weather Research Alliance Singapore was established last September.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: Last September, we established the Climate and Weather Research Alliance Singapore (CAWRAS) to advance tropical climate and weather research for Singapore and Southeast Asia.

key_points.point: CAWRAS is implementing a $25 million Weather Science Research Programme.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: CAWRAS is implementing a $25 million Weather Science Research Programme, which will raise our capability in weather forecasts and climate projections.

key_points.point: The heat stress sensor network is being expanded from nine sensors in 2023 to 20 today, with more to be installed island-wide.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We are expanding our heat stress sensor network from nine sensors in 2023 to 20 today and will install more sensors island-wide.

key_points.point: The Government will conduct focus group discussions and a public exhibition this year.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: This year, the Government will conduct a series of engagements, including focus group discussions and a public exhibition.

key_points.point: The SG Eco Fund will broaden its funding scope to include adaptation.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: To encourage ground-up initiatives, the SG Eco Fund will broaden its funding scope to include adaptation.

key_points.point: MSE has established a new Heat Resilience Policy Office.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: We are happy to announce that MSE has established a new Heat Resilience Policy Office.

key_points.point: The RIE2030 Heat Resilience R&D Programme will be launched.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: We will launch the RIE2030 Heat Resilience R&D Programme, to advance capabilities and investments in heat resilience research through two complementary pillars

key_points.point: A $40 million Adapting to Heat Impacts Funding Initiative will be launched.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: we will launch a $40 million "Adapting to Heat Impacts" Funding Initiative

key_points.point: The Climate Friendly Households Programme will be expanded next month to include five-tick clothes dryers and induction stoves.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: Next month, we will expand its eligibility to include five-tick clothes dryers and induction stoves.

key_points.point: The Beverage Container Return Scheme is expected to recover over 16,000 tonnes of material every year for recycling.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: With the scheme, we expect to recover over 16,000 tonnes of material every year for recycling.

key_points.point: Over 1,000 Return Right reverse vending machines are to be deployed by 1 April.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: Efforts are underway to deploy over 1,000 Return Right reverse vending machines (RVMs) by 1 April

key_points.point: The number of reverse vending machines will progressively increase to 2,000 within the first year.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: We will progressively increase the RVMs deployed to 2,000 within the first year

key_points.point: Consumers can get their 10-cent deposit refunded via SimplyGo EZ-Link cards and concession cards and DBS PayLah!.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: where consumers can get their 10-cent deposit refunded via SimplyGo EZ-Link cards and concession cards and DBS PayLah!

key_points.point: A one-time support of $500 per food shop will be provided on application for Return Right F&B outlets.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: We will therefore provide a one-time support of $500 per food shop on application.

key_points.point: Major supermarkets will display beverage prices on shelves without including the 10-cent deposit and charge the deposit at checkout.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: They have collectively decided to display beverage prices on shelves without including the 10-cent deposit, and reflect that the deposit will be charged at checkout.

key_points.point: Since October 2025, 39 surveillance cameras have been deployed under the high-rise littering pilot with Town Councils, with a 30% catch-rate.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: Since the pilot started in October 2025, 39 cameras have been deployed with a 30% catch-rate, an encouraging result from our closer collaboration.

key_points.point: Smoking prohibitions have been expanded to over 49,000 public places across Singapore, up from 32,000 in 2021.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: NEA has progressively expanded smoking prohibitions to over 49,000 public places across Singapore, up from 32,000 in 2021.

key_points.point: Thermal cameras effectively detected smoking offences in about 44% of deployments.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: These cameras effectively detected smoking offences in about 44% of deployments.

key_points.point: Project Wolbachia will cover 740,000 households by March 2026, up from 580,000 households in April 2025.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: NEA has also expanded Project Wolbachia, which will cover 740,000 households by March 2026, up from 580,000 households in April 2025.

key_points.point: The Singapore Food Story 2 includes four pillars: diversify imports, grow local, stockpile and global partnerships.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: It includes four pillars: diversify imports, grow local, stockpile and global partnerships.

key_points.point: A new tranche of $70 million under the ACT Fund 2 is being announced.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: Today, I am announcing a new tranche of funding of $70 million under the ACT Fund 2.

key_points.point: The ACT Fund 2 will be made available from April 2026 over five years.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: This will be made available from April 2026, over five years

key_points.point: A new Industry Partnerships for Capability Transformation Grant will be introduced under the ACT Fund 2.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: At the same time, it will introduce a new funding component – the Industry Partnerships for Capability Transformation Grant.

key_points.point: The national breeding programme will be expanded to include Red Snapper and work towards increasing supply of Whiteleg shrimp larvae and grouper fingerlings.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: This year, we will expand our national breeding programme to include Red Snapper and work towards industry-led efforts to increase the supply of Whiteleg shrimp larvae and grouper fingerlings.

key_points.point: Sales for xiao bai cai under the SG Farmers' Market brand have increased about sevenfold since May 2024.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: For example, the sales for xiao bai cai under the "SG Farmers' Market" brand have increased about sevenfold since its launch in May 2024.

key_points.point: A new risk monitoring dashboard and food supply visibility tool has been developed with PSA BDP.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: Our new risk monitoring dashboard and food supply visibility tool, developed with PSA BDP, provides early warnings of developments that may affect food imports and strengthens Singapore's upstream food supply chain visibility.

key_points.point: Starting 1 May 2026, up to $5 million over two years will be committed under the Climate Adaptation Package of the SG Eco Fund.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: Starting 1 May 2026, we will commit up to $5 million over two years to fund projects, like HeatAware SG, that build awareness and inspire action on climate adaptation topics.

key_points.point: Applications for the Climate Adaptation Package will be open all year-round, and funding for supportable project costs will increase from 80% to 90%.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: We will open applications all year-round and increase funding for supportable project costs from 80% to 90%.

key_points.point: The Flood Resilient Developments Guidebook will be launched in mid-2026 on PUB's website.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: The Guidebook will be launched in mid-2026 on PUB's website.

key_points.point: Over 16,000 portable flood barriers have already been distributed and distribution continues throughout this year.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: We have already distributed over 16,000 of these barriers and are continuing throughout this year.

key_points.point: PUB flood alerts can be received on Telegram, X or the MyENV app.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: Join us and act now by subscribing to PUB's flood alerts on Telegram, X or on the MyENV app.

key_points.point: Since 2020, the SG Eco Fund has awarded over $21 million to support close to 500 initiatives, engaging over 700,000 individuals.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: Since 2020, the SG Eco Fund has awarded over $21 million to support close to 500 initiatives, engaging over 700,000 individuals.

key_points.point: There are about one million subscribers who have downloaded the myENV app.
key_points.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
key_points.quote: We have about one million subscribers who have downloaded the myENV app.

key_points.point: NEA specifies a minimum collection frequency of three times a week for smaller blue bins and once a week for larger-capacity 2,200-litre side-loader recycling bins in HDB estates.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: NEA specifies a minimum collection frequency of three times a week for the smaller blue bins and once a week for the larger-capacity 2,200-litre side-loader recycling bins in HDB estates.

key_points.point: When a subsidised stall is transferred to an immediate family member of the first-generation subsidised rent-holder, a special provision allows subsidised rental rate.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: when a subsidised stall is transferred to an immediate family member of the first-generation subsidised rent-holder, we have a special provision to allow him or her to pay subsidised rental rate.

key_points.point: For transfers to other family members and relatives, a reasonable timeframe of three years is provided for rent to be staggered from subsidised rent to market rent.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: we provide a reasonable timeframe of three years for the rent to be staggered from subsidised rent to market rent.

key_points.point: Under ACT 1, about $55 million has been funded in the last few years, covering about 150 projects across 60 companies.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: we have funded about $55 million in the last few years under ACT 1, and that covers about 150 projects across 60 companies.

key_points.point: About two out of 60 companies have folded, which is about a 3% failure rate.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: only about two out of 60, so that is about a 3% failure rate.

key_points.point: On food waste, the short answer is yes, and MSE wants to improve food waste management and encourage stakeholders to participate.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: the short answer is, yes. We do indeed want to improve our food waste management and encourage all the stakeholders involved to participate.

key_points.point: Decals are available if F&B outlets sign up to be part of the Return Right F&B scheme.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: The decals are available if the F&B outlets sign up to be part of the "Return Right" F&B scheme.

key_points.point: The SG Eco Fund does not currently measure outcomes in terms of waste reduced or energy saved.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: Today, we do not measure the outcomes in terms of the way that the Member has described, in terms of waste reduced or energy saved.

key_points.point: AI-enabled technology is already being piloted together with visual recognition technology for detection of offences.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: Certainly, AI-enabled technology is already being piloted together with some visual recognition technology for the purposes of detection of offences, such as Ms Lee had described.

key_points.point: On alternative proteins, the position is still in play.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: On alternative proteins, that is still in play.

key_points.point: MSE is still continuing to fund research and development costs for a number of alternative protein outfits in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: We are still continuing to fund research and development (R&D) costs for a number of these outfits out here in Singapore.

key_points.point: On global partnerships, the work is fairly nascent and a report will be made when the time comes.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: But do give us a bit of time because this is fairly nascent and new, but certainly, we will make a report when the time comes.

key_points.point: The pool of stall assistants was recently expanded to include Long-Term Visit Pass and LTVP+ holders already in Singapore.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: We recently expanded the pool to include Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) and LTVP+ holders who are already in Singapore and can contribute to our economy.

key_points.point: The impact of the LTVP and LTVP+ expansion will be monitored, and further moves will be contemplated if necessary.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: We will monitor the impact because this is a very recent move and we will contemplate further moves if necessary.

key_points.point: The Lim Chu Kang masterplan remains central to master-planning, though it is longer term.
key_points.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
key_points.quote: I just want to assure the Member that the Lim Chu Kang masterplan, though I have not mentioned it in my speech, is pretty much still central to our master-planning – just that it is a bit more longer term

key_points.point: Flood monitoring capabilities have been enhanced through water level sensors and closed-circuit televisions so PUB can deploy quick response teams.
key_points.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
key_points.quote: we have then enhanced our flood monitoring capabilities through water level sensors and closed-circuit televisions so that PUB ourselves can deploy quick response teams as fast as possible in times of flood.

key_points.point: Work is in progress to increase specificity and sensitivity so that AI detection does not generate too many false positives or false negatives.
key_points.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
key_points.quote: The issue is to increase the specificity and sensitivity, so that we are not generating too many false positives or false negatives through this, and so that work is in progress.

what_happens_next: Ms Poh Li San sought leave to withdraw her amendment; the Coastal Protection Bill will be tabled for Second Reading; the National Adaptation Plan will be published in 2027; the ACT Fund 2 will be available from April 2026; and the SG Eco Fund Climate Adaptation Package starts 1 May 2026.
